claims.assertion: Mari contrasts the Federation account of Etorthans leaving the Orion Council with the Urmah claim that they led attacks on Urmah settlements.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu, relaying Federation and Urmah accounts
claims.qualifiers: The accounts conflict; Mari does not resolve them.

claims.assertion: The Urmah say they repelled an Orion invasion at Rigel 7, where Etorthans fought alongside a larger Orion alliance.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu, relaying Urmah account
claims.qualifiers: The Urmah describe this as a late Orion Wars battle.

claims.assertion: Urmah leaders distrust Etorthans and reject their political authority; Avyon’s High Council has longstanding cooperation treaties with Alcyone and Taygetans.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu, relaying Urmah claims

review_flags: Contradictory Federation and Urmah accounts of Etorthan history and alignment.
coverage_gaps: Etorthan biology and other claims omitted
